responsibility: Declares default-channel decimal text I/O for LONGREAL values. It mirrors LongIO’s explicit-channel operations but binds them to the current standard input and output channels, providing read and write procedures for floating, engineering, fixed, and width-adaptive output forms in the ISO default-stream style.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface for default-channel LONGREAL text I/O, declaring the read and write procedures available to callers. It differs from SLongIO.mod, which implements those entry points as wrappers around LongIO on StdChans standard channels.
